title: Transactional process ownership attachment
goal: Ensure every failure after Process.Start leaves no process or native ownership resource.

tasks.description: Restructure StartSessionAsync so process and partial ownership state are visible to one total cleanup path.
Add an explicit abort operation or equivalent for ownership-start objects.
On Windows attachment failure, close the Job Object and terminate the unassigned root process.
On Unix attachment/resume failure, terminate the established process group when observable, otherwise terminate the root tree.
Do not return an identity until boundary and executable identity are established.
Add deterministic Windows/Unix-friendly tests using an injected attach failure.
